evidence_rule: Cases are frozen targets, not passing results. Agent narration, source code or prebuilt mesh alone cannot satisfy a case. Resolve every semantic action to the actual admitted product interface and independently read back the in-app Part.
setup_rule: setup_case means replay its normal application actions in the current case own fresh Part. It does not authorize direct-store seeding or reuse of a different run Part.

cases.name: Origin-anchored rectangular plate
cases.user_request: Create a new Part in this project: an 80 x 50 x 6 mm plate, Front plane, corner at the sketch origin. Model it in the application and leave it open.

cases.name: Concentric annular spacer
cases.user_request: Create a new in-app spacer Part: OD 30 mm, ID 10 mm, length 12 mm, concentric at the Front-plane origin.

cases.name: Blind circular pocket
cases.user_request: Create a new 80 x 50 x 6 mm plate Part, then a top-face diameter 10 mm 3 mm deep blind pocket at x=20, y=20. Use a second sketch and actual cut feature.

cases.name: Through-all circular cut
cases.user_request: Create a new 80 x 50 x 6 mm plate Part, then a top-face diameter 10 mm through-all cut at x=20, y=20. Use a second sketch and actual cut feature.

cases.name: Face-supported merged boss
cases.user_request: Create a new plate Part 80 x 50 x 6 mm, then add a merged top-face boss 20 x 10 x 4 mm with its sketch corner at x=30, y=20.

cases.name: Edit upstream depth and rebuild dependent boss
cases.user_request: Create the plate-and-boss Part, then edit the original plate extrusion from 6 mm to 9 mm. Rebuild the same Part; its top-supported boss must follow, with previous revisions unchanged.

cases.name: Trim and mirror a closed extrusion profile
cases.user_request: Create the specified stepped half-profile with lines, trim the terminal segment, mirror-copy it across the local vertical axis into one closed profile, and extrude 6 mm.
cases.mirror_scope: Copy-mirror creation case; no claim of general associative mirror editing.

cases.name: PVC straight slip coupler with center stop
cases.user_request: Create a new in-application review Part: straight slip coupler labelled nominal 1-inch PVC, length 60 mm, OD 42 mm, two sockets ID 33.6 mm and depth 28.5 mm each, leaving a 3 mm center stop with a 26.6 mm opening. Keep it open in this project; do not substitute OpenSCAD text.

clarification_variant.resolve: Ask whether straight slip coupler, elbow, tee or threaded; use straight slip coupler after the user confirms. Explain nominal size versus literal diameter. Record any additional prototype defaults before application actions.

cases.engineering_claim: Software acceptance fixture only. Dimensions are supplied prototype inputs, not verified fitting tolerances or pressure/solvent-weld certification.

cases.name: Workplane-correct revolved bushing
cases.user_request: Create a new bushing Part by revolving a radial section on Top/XZ around the in-plane Z axis: OD 20 mm, ID 10 mm, length 20 mm. Do not reinterpret an XY sketch as a different plane.

cases.name: Through-hole linear pattern
cases.user_request: Create a new 80 x 50 x 6 mm mounting plate Part with a simple diameter 5 mm through hole at x=15,y=15, then pattern that hole along X at 20 mm spacing with three total instances including the seed.

cases.name: Four vertical-corner fillet
cases.user_request: Create a new 80 x 50 x 6 mm plate Part and apply a 2 mm radius fillet to exactly the four vertical outside corner edges, not the top/bottom rim.
cases.finish_scope: Bounded vertical outer perimeter only; no arbitrary-edge surgery claim.

cases.name: Four vertical-corner chamfer
cases.user_request: Create a new 80 x 50 x 6 mm plate Part and apply a 2 x 2 mm equal-distance chamfer to exactly the four vertical outside corner edges, not the top/bottom rim.
cases.finish_scope: Bounded vertical outer perimeter only; no arbitrary-edge surgery claim.
